global: This shio ramen boasts a clear, golden broth, topped with chashu pork, nori seaweed, and menma bamboo shoots arranged neatly. Served in a rustic white bowl, it rests on a dark wooden table under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark brown wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, forming a circular boundary around the bowl.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with speckled glaze, smooth rounded rim, and subtle brownish discoloration along its inner edge.
regions.soup: The shio (salt) broth is golden-yellow, glossy, and gently bubbling, cradling noodles and toppings in a shallow, curved bowl.
regions.seaweed: The nori seaweed is dark green, crinkled, and irregularly shaped with a slightly glossy, textured surface.
regions.meat: Chashu pork slice shows layered fat and lean meat, glistening surface with visible marbling and slight char.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, sliced into thick pieces with visible fibrous texture and slight sheen.
